scope: Corollary 8.4 (Reduction to complete parabolics) of the manuscript “Parabolic intersections in Artin groups” (preprints/Parabolic-intersections-in-Artin-groups-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 254 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4cd7fa316371447c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 53. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A = AM with S finite. (i) Every subgroup of A with property FA′ lies in a complete parabolic subgroup. (ii) Every abstract homomorphism L → A from an almost-connected locally compact Hausdorff group has image in a complete parabolic. (iii) If every complete standard parabolic of A is lcH-slender, then A is lcH-slender.
